automaticDownload.offlineQualification: Initial shell-UID wifi disable returned137 and was not treated as offline success. Root svc wifi disable subsequently returned successfully and wifi_on=0; mobile_data=0. Independent new-process reader image was opened while no default network was reported. Setting airplane_mode_on=1 alone failed its protected broadcast, so airplane-mode activation itself is NOT claimed.

secondNewEvent.initialFailureCauseQualification: Host transport change coincided with success for the same public bytes and production downloader. It is evidence of host HTTP/1.0 transport incompatibility in this scenario, not a proven production-code root-cause diagnosis. No production fix was applied.
